Formula: Land value = plot size (Marla) × DC rate per Marla. Structure value = covered area (sq ft) × structure rate per sq ft (only if "Yes" for structure). Combined value = land value + structure value. Stamp duty and TTIP tax are each 1% of combined value; an additional 2% applies if a structure exists and its plan is unapproved. Fixed charges: registration Rs. 500, PLRA Rs. 3,600, local commission Rs. 5,500. Estimate only — actual government charges can vary.
